ideas.title: Surface deferred milestones on the path (lane or --include flag)
ideas.body:
# Context

Today the `raul path` / `mp path` surfaces filter out `execution_status: deferred` milestones entirely — they are invisible to the actionable-work view, and the only way to find them is `mp list milestones --where 'execution_status==deferred'` (or the milestones tab in `raul`). With `deferred count = 1` (M158) this is fine; once deferrals accumulate across cycles, "I forgot M158 existed" becomes the failure mode.

The deferred/blocked distinction in the data model is ORTHOGONAL (both are filtered out of path today, both have different resolution workflows — `reopen` for deferred, `unblock` for blocked), but they share the same user-facing problem: neither is reachable from the path tab.

# Problem

Operating path tabs that filter out "not-now" milestones make reversibility expensive:
- `mp milestone reopen <id>` is a deliberate command the agent has to remember.
- The deferral reason is buried in the milestone JSON; nothing in the path surface reminds the operator what was parked and why.
- Audit hygiene degrades: deferred milestones rot when out of sight.

# Proposal (deferred-friendly shape)

Two-tier design, scale-gated:

| Project state       | Surface                                                                                  |
|---------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0-3 deferred        | Add `--include deferred` flag to `mp path` / `raul path` (one-key toggle, hidden by default). Blocked can ride the same flag. |
| 4+ deferred         | Promote to a real `Deferred` lane in `raul`, last position. Header shows count (`Deferred (4)`), default-collapsed so the lane list stays short. Symmetric treatment for `Blocked`. |

# Open questions

1. In-lane action affordance — read-only list with "use `mp milestone reopen <id>`" help text, or one-key in-place `reopen`?  Start read-only.
2. Naming: `Deferred` vs `Parked`. (Avoid `Backlog` — that surface already exists for non-milestone-scoped deferrals.)
3. Same treatment for `Blocked`? Symmetric — yes per the orthogonal-but-similar UX argument.
4. Ordering inside the lane/flag — by deferral date? by id? by priority?
5. CLI parity: does `mp path` get a `deferred:` section in its output too, or is this TUI-only?

# Stretch

- Per-agent handoff: the runner can carry a "deferred backlog" page in the lane so the human can sweep reopens between sessions.
- Visibility into why a milestone is blocked (vs deferred) at a glance in the lane header.

# Tags

`path`, `raul`, `deferred`, `ux`, `tui`. Promote to milestone when `deferred count >= 4` (currently 1 with M158).

ideas.title: raul TUI settings: skill/component manager — list installable agents + skills, install/reinstall
ideas.body: Today install/reinstall of agent + skill components is CLI-only (mp install, mp install --list-skills, mp install --check for drift). Add a settings screen in the raul TUI that acts as a skill/component file manager: enumerate every installable agent and skill component from the mp skill registry, show per-harness deployment state (installed / missing / stale), and let the human install, reinstall, or remove components. Reuses the existing mp install machinery (registry + per-harness deploy) behind a TUI surface, giving a visible, manageable view of what is deployed across OpenCode/Cursor/Pi and surfacing drift interactively. Scope hint: read side = mp install --list-skills --format json + mp install --check; write side wraps mp install / mp uninstall with a confirmation step.
